chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, then All Streams Flow to the Sea, then Itto — Superlative Superstrength, all targeting Sludge Spinner. This deals 33 damage and gains 6 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, Itto — Superlative Superstrength, and Bake-Kurage, trading immediate damage for the summon, 1 Charge, and Burst +5.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up summoning Bake-Kurage, gaining 1 Charge, and building Burst +5 in exchange for more immediate damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger incoming attack would have made me consider spending more energy on Coral Guard for additional Block.
